描述_EN: officials would have spent considerable time entertaining guests, such as the one who inspired this figure, from near and far. he sports a spectacularly well-groomed beard, a large pot-belly and a helmet-like hat. regular embassies seeking trade, peace, war and marriage alliances required hospitality. the dress, hat and features probably specified a particular foreign group.the man here is possibly a foreign dignitary. because of their position on a major trade route, silk road towns experienced a regular traffic of people passing through, many demanding attention from the local officials. many ethic groups can be identified in the tomb figures of the sui and tang dynasties. this glazed earthenware figure represents a foreign dignitary. this variety reflects the cosmopolitan flavour of life in towns along the silk road and in the capital, chang'an (present day xi'an). the chinese potters who modelled this type of figure clearly intended to show non-chinese.
描述_ZN: 官员们会花相当多的时间来招待来自远近的客人，比如这个人物的灵感。 他留着漂亮的胡子，有一个大肚子，戴着头盔似的帽子。 寻求贸易、和平、战争和婚姻联盟的定期使团需要受到款待。 衣着、帽子和特征可能指定了一个特定的外国群体，这里的人可能是一个外国政要。 由于处于主要贸易路线上，丝绸之路上的城镇经常有很多人经过，很多人要求当地官员关注。 在隋唐时期的墓葬人物中，可以发现许多种族群体。 这个釉面陶器形象代表了一位外国政要。 这种多样性反映了丝绸之路沿线城镇和首都长安（今西安）的世界性生活气息。 中国的陶艺家们为这种人物建模，显然是为了表现非中国人。
